questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words. Detailed list of goods dispatched with quantity and price to the purchaser.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words. To criticise someone severely

To criticise someone severely
questions.solution: The correct one-word substitute is "Chastise." To chastise means to criticize someone severely or punish them, especially verbally. It fits the description of severe criticism more accurately than the other options, making it the appropriate choice for this scenario.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Happening repeatedly

Happening repeatedly
questions.solution: The term "recurrent" is the correct one-word substitute for something that happens repeatedly. questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words. A disease that is found in a particular place and is difficult to get rid of.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.

A disease that is found in a particular place and is difficult to get rid of.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Endemic'.

Key Points

  • Let us explore the given options:-
    • 'Chronic' is (of an illness) persisting for a long time or constantly recurring.
      • Example: If left untreated the condition may become chronic.
    • 'Pandemic' is (of a disease) prevalent over a whole country or the world.
      • Example: All countries should immediately activate their pandemic preparedness plans.
    • 'Infection' is the process of infecting or the state of being infected.
      • Example: She has got an ear infection.
    • 'Endemic' is (of a disease or condition) regularly found among particular people or in a certain area.
      • Example: Chest disease is endemic among miners in this area.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. To the utmost or most absolute extent or degree

To the utmost or most absolute extent or degree

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined part of the given sentence. Dogs are known for possession of the quality of being faithful.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined part of the given sentence.

Dogs are known for possession of the quality of being faithful.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Fidelity."

 Key Points

  • Being faithful indicates loyalty and steadfastness. (वफादारी)
    • Example: Dogs are known for their exceptional faithfulness to their owners.
  • Fidelity means faithfulness to a person, cause, or belief, demonstrated by continuing loyalty and support. (निष्ठा) 
    • Example: The fidelity of the dog to its owner is often cited as a prime example of unshakeable loyalty.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4) Fidelity.

 Additional Information

  • Honesty means the quality of being honest; truthfulness. (ईमानदारी)
  • Genuineness means the quality of being genuine; authenticity. (वास्तविकता)
  • Creditability means the quality, capability, or power to elicit belief. (विश्वसनीयता)

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A funeral procession
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A funeral procession
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. 'Cortege'.

Key Points

  • A "funeral procession" refers to the ceremonial procession of people moving together at a funeral, often from a religious place of worship or a home to the graveyard.
  • The most suitable one-word substitute for "funeral procession" from the given options is: Cortege 
  • This term specifically refers to a solemn procession, especially for a funeral. (शव यात्रा).

Therefore, the correct answer is: 'Cortege'.

Additional Information

  • Now, let's examine the other options:
    • Constellation - In astronomy, a constellation is a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern. In a broader sense, it can mean a group or cluster of related things(नक्षत्र समूह).
    • Claque - This is a group of sycophantic followers, or it can refer to a group of people hired to applaud a performer or public speaker.(तालियां बजाने वालों की टोली).
    • Congregation - This generally refers to a gathering or collection of people, animals, or things. It is often used to refer to a group of people assembled for religious worship(सभा).

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Officially make a student leave a school for ever.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Officially make a student leave a school for ever.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Expel.

Key Points

 The meanings of the given words are as follows:​ 

  •   Evacuate: remove (someone) from a place of danger to a safer place. 
  •   Expel: officially make (someone) leave a school or other organization.
  •   Eject: force or throw (something) out in a violent or sudden way.
  •   Exclude: deny (someone) access to a place, group, or privilege.
  • From the given meanings above, we are sure that a one-word substitute for the given group of words is 'Expel'.

Hence, the most suitable option is Option 2.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Someone who does not care about rules

Someone who does not care about rules

questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words. Move suddenly and powerfully forward or upward
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

Move suddenly and powerfully forward or upward
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Surge".

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given words:
  • Surge: a sudden powerful forward or upward movement, especially by a crowd or by a natural force such as the tide.
  • Thrive: to prosper; be fortunate or successful.
  • Abound: to occur or exist in great quantities or numbers.
  • Flourish: to be in its or in one's prime; be at the height of fame, excellence, influence, etc.
  • The meaning of the word 'surge' is closest to that of the given group of words.
    • Example: The crowd surged towards the stadium when their team started winning.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Hinglish

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given words:
  • Surge: एक अचानक शक्तिशाली आगे या ऊपर की ओर गति, विशेष रूप से भीड़ द्वारा या ज्वार जैसी प्राकृतिक शक्ति द्वारा।
  • Thrive: समृद्ध करना; भाग्यशाली हो या सफल।
  • Abound: बड़ी मात्रा में या संख्या में होना या होना।
  • Flourish: इसके या किसी के प्रमुख में होना; प्रसिद्धि, उत्कृष्टता, प्रभाव आदि की ऊंचाई पर हो।
  • The meaning of the word 'surge' is closest to that of the given group of words.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given. Force someone through fear to do or not to do something
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.

Force someone through fear to do or not to do something
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Intimidate'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Intimidate'.
  • It means 'to frighten or threaten somebody, often in order to make him/her do something'. [किसी को डराना या धमकाना (प्रायः कोई काम करवाने के लिए)]
    • Example: She refused to be intimidated by their threats.
       

Correct Answer: Intimidate.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Control: power and ability to make somebody/something do what you want. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु पर नियंत्रण, संचालन, क़ाबू में रखने की क्षमता)
    • Subjugate: to defeat somebody/something and make them obey you; to gain control over somebody/something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु को परास्‍त करना; किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का दमन करना या उसे अपने अधीन करना)
    • Murder: the crime of killing a person illegally and on purpose. (ग़ैर-क़ानूनी रूप से और जान-बूझकर किसी व्यक्ति को मार देने का अपराध, मानव हत्‍या का अपराध)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given. A shortage of vitamins, minerals, etc. needed for good health
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.

A shortage of vitamins, minerals, etc. needed for good health
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Deficiency'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Deficiency'.
  • It means "the lack of something that is needed in order to meet a particular standard or level of quality or the thing that is lacking; a shortage of vitamins, minerals, etc. needed for good health." (किसी विशेष मानक या गुणवत्ता के स्तर या जो चीज की कमी है उसे पूरा करने के लिए आवश्यक किसी चीज की कमी; अच्छे स्वास्थ्य के लिए आवश्यक विटामिन, खनिजों आदि की कमी)
    • Example: a deficiency of vitamin C...
       

Correct Answer: Deficiency.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Nutrition: the food that you eat and the way that it affects your health. (स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य को पुष्‍ट करने वाला भोजन, पोषाहार)
    • Defect: something that is wrong with or missing from somebody/something. (दोष, ख़राबी या त्रुटि)
    • Disease: an illness of the body in humans, animals, or plants. [रोग]

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is best substitute of the phrase. An elaborate musical composition for full orchestra, typically in four movements, at least one of which is traditionally in sonata form
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is best substitute of the phrase.

An elaborate musical composition for full orchestra, typically in four movements, at least one of which is traditionally in sonata form
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Symphony'

Key Points

The meanings of the given words are-

  • Symphony- Elaborate musical composition for full orchestra, typically.
  • Sound- Vibrations that travel through the air or another medium and are sensed by the ear.
  • Melodious- pleasant sounding; tuneful.
  • Musical- relating to or accompanied by music.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 2 i.e. symphony.

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words. An additional remark at the end of a letter after the signature
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

An additional remark at the end of a letter after the signature
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Postscript.'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Postscript - an extra message or an additional remark that is added at the end of a letter, note, etc. (पत्र आदि के अंत में जोड़ा गया अतिरिक्त संदेश या सूचना)
    • Abbreviation - a short form of a word or phrase. (किसी शब्‍द या पदबंध का संक्षिप्‍त रूप; संक्षेपण; लघु रूप)
    • Attachment - a document that you send to somebody using email. (ई-पत्र के साथ प्रेषित दस्‍तावेज़, फ़ोटो आदि सामग्री)
    • Salutation - a greeting in words or actions, or the words used at the beginning of a letter or speech. (शब्दों या कार्यों में अभिवादन, या किसी पत्र या भाषण की शुरुआत में इस्तेमाल किए गए शब्द)​

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. To take something on loan with the intention of returning it.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

To take something on loan with the intention of returning it.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Borrow'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Borrow'.
  • It means 'to take or receive something from somebody/something that you intend to give back, usually after a short time' (उधार, कर्ज़ या ऋण लेना)
    • Example: I had to borrow from the bank to pay for my car.
       

Correct Answer: Borrow.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Lease: a legal agreement that allows you to use a building or land for a fixed period of time in return for rent. (एक क़ानूनी क़रारनामा जिसके अनुसार किसी भवन या भूखंड को निर्धारित अवधि के लिए किराए पर लिया जाता है; पट्टा, लीज़, इज़ारा)
    • Lend: to allow somebody to use something for a short time or to give somebody money that must be paid back after a certain period of time. (थोड़े समय के लिए उधार देना)
    • Hire: to have the use of something for a short time by paying for it. किसी वस्‍तु को किराए पर लेना

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase. Government by person of highest social order.
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.

Government by person of highest social order.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Aristocracy".

Key Points

  • Let's find out the meaning of the following words:-
  • Autocracy -a system of government by one person with absolute power. 
  • Aristocracy - the highest class in certain societies, typically comprising people of noble birth holding hereditary titles and offices.
    • Noble person is a person of the highest social order who belongs to rank, title, or birth to the aristocracy.
  • Plutocracy - government by the wealthy.
  • Democracy - a system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.

Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. The cry of a goat

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given. Breathe hard and with difficulty
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.

Breathe hard and with difficulty
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Pant'.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Strangle: to kill somebody by squeezing his/her neck or throat with your hands, a rope, etc. [(हाथ, रस्‍सी आदि से) गरदन या गला घोंट कर किसी को मार देना]
    • Choke: to be or to make somebody unable to breathe because something is stopping air from getting into the lungs. (दम घुटना या घोटना)
    • Cough: to send air out of your throat and mouth with a sudden loud noise, especially when you have a cold, have something in your throat, etc. (गले, मुँह आदि से अचानक ज़ोर की आवाज़ के साथ वायु बाहर निकालना विशेषकर जब ज़ुकाम हो गया हो; खाँसना)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. A mass of wax cells built by honey bees to store honey
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A mass of wax cells built by honey bees to store honey
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Honeycomb'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Honeycomb'.
  • It means 'a structure of holes (cells) with six sides, in which bees keep their eggs and the substance they produce (honey) [छोटे-छोटे छिद्रोंवाली एक संरचना जिसमें मधुमक्खियाँ अपने अंडे तथा अपने द्वारा तैयार पदार्थ रखती हैं; शहद का छत्ता]'.
    • Example: They are in fact, more complex structures involving a honeycomb of cracks and crevices in which bacteria thrive.
       

Correct Answer: Honeycomb.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Aviary: a large cage or area in which birds are kept. (पक्षीशाला, दरबा)
    • Beehive: a type of box that people use for keeping bees in. (मधुमक्‍खी-पेटिका, मधुमक्‍खी का छत्ता)
    • Apiary: a place where bees are kept. (मधुवाटिका)

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase. Return the same sort of attack
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase. 

Return the same sort of attack
questions.solution:
Confiscate = take away; take into custody.

Subjugate =conquer; defeat.

Retaliate = attack back.

Alleviate = make less severe.

Hence, Option 3) Retaliate is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. The policy of racial discrimination
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

The policy of racial discrimination
questions.solution:
The correct solution is option is 2.

'Apartheid' is a policy or system of segregation or discrimination on grounds of race or segregation on grounds other than race.

So, the most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Apartheid'.

Let us look into the meaning of other words:

  • 'Inequality' means the difference in size, degree, circumstances, etc.; lack of equality.
  • 'Segregation' means the action or state of setting someone or something apart from others.
  • 'Supremacy' means the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. A specialist who treats diseases of the nervous system
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A specialist who treats diseases of the nervous system
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

Orthopedician means a specialist who deals with the correction of deformities of bones or muscles.

A pediatrician means a medical practitioner specializing in children and their diseases.

Neurologist means a specialist who treats diseases of the nervous system

Gynecologist means a physician or surgeon qualified to practise in gynaecology.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. A hollow space in a wall for a statue or ornament
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A hollow space in a wall for a statue or ornament
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

Nook means a corner or recess, especially one offering seclusion or security.

Slot means a long, narrow aperture or slit in a machine for something to be inserted.

Niche means a hollow space in a wall for a statue or ornament

Cornice means an ornamental moulding round the wall of a room just below the ceiling.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given groups of words. An underground place for storing wine
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given groups of words.

An underground place for storing wine
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Cellar'

Key Points

Let's look at the meaning of the words and an example:

  • Cellar:  a room below ground level in a house. often used for storing wine or coal (एक घर में जमीनी स्तर के नीचे एक कमरा। अक्सर शराब या कोयले के भंडारण के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है)
  • Loft: a space at the top of a building under the roof used for storing things and usually entered by a ladder. (छत के नीचे एक इमारत के शीर्ष पर एक स्थान जिसका उपयोग सामान रखने के लिए किया जाता है और आमतौर पर सीढ़ी द्वारा प्रवेश किया जाता है।)
  • Attic: the art of a building, especially of a house directly under a roof (एक इमारत की कला, विशेष रूप से एक छत के नीचे सीधे घर की)
  • Niche: a hollow in a wall especially one made to put a statue in so that it can be seen. (एक दीवार में एक खोखला विशेष रूप से एक मूर्ति लगाने के लिए बनाया गया है ताकि उसे देखा जा सके।)
     

So the correct one-word substitution for the given group of words is Cellar.

  • Example: Kevin went to the cellar to get a brand new bottle of wine.

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given. Forgive or pardon some wrongdoing or an offence
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.

Forgive or pardon some wrongdoing or an offence
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Condone.'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Condone - to regard or treat something wrong or an offence as acceptable, forgivable, or harmless; accept (behaviour that is considered morally wrong or offensive); approve or sanction (something), especially with reluctance. (अधिकांश लोगों द्वारा ग़लत मानी जाने वाली बात की अनदेखी करना, उपेक्षा करना)
    • Condemn - to say strongly that you think somebody or something is very bad or wrong. (किसी की तीव्र निंदा करना; दोषी या अपराधी ठहराना)
    • Condole - to express sympathy for someone; grieve with. (किसी के प्रति सहानुभूति व्यक्त करना; शोक मनाना)
    • Convict - to say officially in a court of law that somebody is guilty of a crime. (न्‍यायालय द्वारा अपराधी या दोषी ठहराया जाना)
      ​

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Important Points

  • The given answer is the closest meaning of the given group of words.
  • You may feel that this isn't the correct one-word for the given group of words but we need to choose our answer from the given options.
  • Thus, 'condone' is the closest in meaning to the given group of words.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. A list of names or things in a special order.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A list of names or things in a special order.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. Catalogue.

  • Directory is a book or website listing individuals or organizations alphabetically or thematically with details.
  • Catalogue is a complete list of items, typically one in alphabetical or other systematic order.
  • Atlas is a book of maps or charts.
  • Dictionary is a book or electronic resource that lists the words of a language (typically in alphabetical order) and gives their meaning, or gives the equivalent words in a different language, often also providing information about pronunciation, origin, and usage.

So, only option 2 is correct.

questions.question: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. To prevent or alter a result or course of events
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

To prevent or alter a result or course of events
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'intervene'

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the word and some examples of the marked option:
    • Intervene: to participate in something so as to prevent or alter a result or course of events.
  • Let's see an example:
    • The United Nations decided to intervene in the Russia-Ukraine war for world peace.

Additional Information

  • The etymology of the word intervene is derived from the Latin word 'intervenire': inter(between) + venire(come)
  • It can be used as both transitive and intransitive verbs.
  • An example of a transitive verb(sentence with subject, object, and verb)
    • "The time is up!" announced the quizmaster as she intervened to declare the scores for the round.
  • An example of the intransitive verb(sentence with subject and verb)
    • The police decided to intervene in the fight between residents of a commercial complex.

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase. Anything tending to move away from center
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.

Anything tending to move away from center
questions.solution:
Explanation:

  • Centrifugal: a force, arising from the body's inertia, which appears to act on a body moving in a circular path
  • Centripetal: a force that acts on a body moving in a circular path and is directed towards the center around which the body is moving
  • Circumcenter: the point at which the perpendicular bisectors of the sides of a triangle intersect

Thus, the correct answer is Option 1) i.e. Centrifugal

questions.question: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. A large open area of land, water or sky
questions.questionHtml:

questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words. The first people to live in an area

questions.question: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. A very steep or overhanging rock face or cliff on a mountain
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

A very steep or overhanging rock face or cliff on a mountain
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Precipice.

Key Points 

  •  Let's look at the meaning of the correct answer-
    • ​Precipice - It is a noun, which means a very steep side of a high mountain or cliff.
      • ​Example: On the latter side, as well as to the former, there was a great precipice.
  • ​​Let's look at the meaning of the other options-
    • Slope - A surface or piece of land that goes downside.
    • Hill - A high area of land, that is not as high as a mountain.
    • Edge - The place where something especially surfaces ends.

​​Therefore, the correct word for "A very steep or overhanging rock face or cliff on a mountain" is a precipice.

Hinglish 

  •  आइए सही उत्तर का अर्थ देखें-
    • ​Precipice - यह एक noun है,जिसका अर्थ है किसी ऊँचे पहाड़ या चट्टान का बहुत ऊँचा भाग।​
      • उदाहरण: On the latter side, as well as to the former, there was a great precipice.
  • आइए अन्य विकल्पों का अर्थ देखें-
    • Slope - एक सतह या भूमि का टुकड़ा जो नीचे की ओर जाता है I
    • Hill - भूमि का एक ऊँचा क्षेत्र, जो पहाड़ जितना ऊँचा नहीं है।
    • Edge - वह स्थान जहाँ कोई वस्तु विशेष रूप से सतह समाप्त होती है।

इसलिए,"A very steep or overhanging rock face or cliff on a mountain"  के लिए सही शब्द precipice है।

questions.question: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. A contest between two people to settle a point of honour
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

A contest between two people to settle a point of honour
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'duel'.

Key Points

  • 'Duel' means a contest with deadly weapons arranged between two people in order to settle a point of honour. (किसी प्रसंग पर आयोजित दो व्‍यक्तियों के बीच सशस्‍त्र यु़द्घ (अतीत में प्रचलित); द्वंद्वयुद्घ)
  • So, the word which means the same as the group of words given is 'duel'. 
    • Example- The two men fought a duel over the lady.
  • Here, 'Duo' means a pair of people or things, especially in music or entertainment. (एक साथ प्रदर्शन करने वाले गायकों या वादकों की जोड़ी; युगलगान, युगलवादन)
    • Example- Minnie and Mickey Mouse are the most famous duo in Disney history.
  • 'Dual' means consisting of two parts, elements, or aspects. (दो अंशों वाला; दोहरा, द्वैत)
    • Example- This room has dual purpose, serving as both a study room and a dining room.
  • 'Duet' means a performance by two singers, instrumentalists, or dancers. (युगलगान या वादन, जुगलबंदी)
    • Example- Simpson sang a duet with her sister.
  • ​Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

questions.question: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. A speech made to oneself
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

A speech made to oneself
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Soliloquy.

Key Points

  • 'Soliloquy' means an act of speaking one's thoughts aloud when by oneself or regardless of any hearers. (आत्मभाषण; स्वयं या किसी श्रोता की परवाह किए बिना अपने विचारों को जोर से बोलने की क्रिया)
  • So, the word which means the same as the group of words given is 'Soliloquy'.
Additional Information
 
  • Let us look into the meaning of other words:
    • 'Dialogue' means a conversation between two or more people as a feature of a book, play, or film. (एक किताब, नाटक या फिल्म की विशेषता के रूप में दो या दो से अधिक लोगों के बीच बातचीत)
    • 'Eloquent' means fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing. (सुवक्ता)
    • 'Solitary' means done or existing alone. (अकेला)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words. To fall apart as a result of decay
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

To fall apart as a result of decay
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Disintegrate.'
Key Points
  • Let's understand the meaning of the given words.
    • 'Disintegrate' means to become weaker or be destroyed by breaking into small pieces.(पृथक करना, अलग करना, विघटित हो जाना)
      • Example: The rocket disintegrated as it entered a specific zone of our country.
    • 'Dishevelled' means untidy or disordered hair, clothes, or appearance of a person.(मैला-कुचैला, अस्त-व्यस्त)
      • Example: I saw a boy with long dishevelled hair.
    • 'Discontinue' means to stop doing or providing something.(बंद करना, रोकना)
      • Example: The company announced that the holiday every Saturday would be discontinued.
    • 'Dislocate' means to force a bone suddenly out of its correct position.(अव्यवस्थित करना, सरकाना)
      • Example: He dislocated his knee while doing some stretching exercises.
  • When we observe the meaning of the given words, we get to know that the word 'disintegrate' serves the same meaning that is asked in the question.
  • Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.
